scenes.line1: How do you reach private VMs
scenes.say: How do you connect to private virtual machines in the cloud without exposing public IP addresses?

scenes.label: Bastion
scenes.sub: Portal or CLI RDP/SSH to VMs, no public IPs.
scenes.say: Azure Bastion lets you connect to your virtual machines using Remote Desktop or SSH, right from the portal or command line, without ever needing a public IP.
Key Vault holds your secrets, keys, and certificates. Role-based access control decides who gets in. Managed identities mean your apps never need passwords in their code.

scenes.label: Just-in-Time
scenes.sub: Admins get rights only when needed.
scenes.say: Just-in-time access and privileged identity management make sure admin rights are only active when you actually need them.

scenes.question: Can you just add a public IP for admin?
scenes.right: Never expose public IPs. Use Bastion, VPN, or a jump host with just-in-time access.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: Is it okay to just add a public IP for admin access? Never do this. Use Bastion, a VPN, or a jump host, and always limit admin access windows.
